result.description: Open-source/commercial ecommerce platform (Adobe Commerce) with REST, GraphQL and SOAP APIs for catalog, orders, customers, and carts on self-hosted stores.
result.auth_detail: Per-store: admin/customer token (username+password exchanged for bearer token), integration OAuth 1.0a (consumer key/secret + access token/secret, created in Admin), session login; Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server for the SaaS (Cloud Service) edition.
result.access_detail: Each merchant store issues its own credentials (Admin > System > Extensions > Integration). Open-source Magento and Adobe Commerce are self-hostable, so a developer can get working creds free on their own instance. No central app review. Every customer has a different store URL (per-tenant base URL).
result.api_notes: REST and GraphQL cover catalog, inventory, customers, carts, orders, invoices, shipments, CMS, etc. SOAP also exists. Tenant-specific base URL needed.
result.blocker: Self-hosted per-tenant stores: user must supply store base URL and create an Admin integration or token; OAuth 1.0a plus token variants differ by PaaS/SaaS edition.

evidence.quote: Third-party applications use OAuth-based authentication to access the web APIs.
The token service returns a unique authentication token in exchange for a username and password for an admin or customer account.
Create a new integration on Admin.
The Web API documentation is divided into three guides: REST, GraphQL, and Getting Started.
